- Drawdown is 75% from the 30-minute high, and the 30-minute return is -73%. Most coins don't recover a dip this deep.
- Sell pressure is high: sell/buy ratio 1.33 in the first two minutes, and the last 15 minutes show 81 sellers against 86 buyers with net flow near zero. Buying recent volume into 33 SOL of sells is catching a falling knife.
- Pool depth is 42 SOL, which is thin. A $20 ticket round trip could cost well above the 1.4-5.1% range.

If the desk overrides: $5 maximum, 20% stop, 15-minute hold, exit on any failed bounce. But the base rates and the chart don't justify it. Skip.
memos.scout:
The honest case for buying DAEMON now is weak, and I'd recommend skipping it.

The strongest points are that the coin is classed ORGANIC, not factory or operator-backed, with no airdrop dump seen, and the curve isn't obviously concentrated: top-3 share is 5.8%, bundle share 12.2%. In the last 15 minutes it is up 2.5% with 86 buyers and buy volume of 34.9 SOL, roughly balanced against 33.5 SOL of sells.

But demand is not clearly sticking around. The coin is down 72.6% over 30 minutes and 74.7% from its 30-minute high. Over the last 15 minutes, sellers (81) nearly matched buyers (86), and sell-to-buy in the launch window was 1.33, meaning early buyers were already exiting. Net flow of 1.37 SOL is essentially zero against a 42 SOL pool, so a $20 ticket would face meaningful slippage against a round trip of 1.4-5.1%. Most coins don't recover a drawdown this deep, and nothing here suggests a catalyst that would hold buyers for the next 30-60 minutes.

There is no solid case for buying. Pass.
memos.skeptic: Most likely loss: dead-cat fade with the drawdown already priced in. Price is down 74.7% from the 30-minute high and 72.6% over 30 minutes, yet the last 15 minutes show a +2.5% return on net flow of just 1.37 SOL (34.86 bought vs 33.49 sold). That is churn, not accumulation. Sellers (81) nearly match buyers (86), and the 1.33 sell-to-buy ratio in the first two minutes after graduation signals early distribution. The launch bot and the 111 SOL of post-graduation buying from 240 wallets are consistent with a bot-driven spike that already exited. With a 42 SOL pool, a 1.4-5.1% round trip is a real hurdle, and a 2.5% bounce could vanish on a single sell. Skip.
